Description: GuardDuty detectors do not have S3 Protection enabled to analyze object-level API activity and identify potential security risks for data stored in S3 buckets.
Risk: Without S3 Protection, object-level S3 API activity (such as GetObject, PutObject, and DeleteObject) is not monitored, which allows unauthorized data exfiltration, mass object deletions, or policy tampering to go unnoticed.

Recommendation.Text: Consider enabling GuardDuty S3 Protection for all detectors across accounts and regions to monitor CloudTrail S3 data events and identify potential security threats on data stored in Amazon S3 buckets.
